name: ledger.customers

get.description: Read one complete native detail root; separate histories and child endpoints are unqueried.

parameters.name: customer-version
parameters.description: Explicit native customer version from the customer page; required context, potentially not echoed by detail.

lookup.name: customerNo
lookup.description: Native customerNo from the customer page, together with the required version context.

result_identity.description: Native returned customerNo; validated against the requested lookup without changing its type.

purpose: Read one native detail through an independent inquiry-only Get capability.
identity_description: Get-only; returned identity is declared by operations.get.
limitations: Native customer detail for explicit customerNo/version. The source may omit version echo, so successful root acquisition does not independently prove the returned version. No latest-version inference or List.
Get and supported List --live --with-detail preserve native types, nesting and unknown fields, perform no implicit history/child inquiries, and write no cache or Duckdog data.
